media.description: Demonstration of the 3D Studio editor, without sound: five fuchsia gems placed on a lateral incisor, lassoed and aligned vertically, then mirror-copied to the other side; a sapphire gem placed on the canine, made larger and mirror-copied; the two lowest gems copied vertically onto the lower arch and turned gold; one gem duplicated and mirror-copied, then the four lower gems aligned, spaced evenly and centred on their teeth; finally the panels close on the finished smile.

items.question: What is the Global Toothgems 3D Studio?
items.answer: An online creative space for composing tooth jewellery: you place pieces on a 3D dentition, move them around, change shapes and colours, and see the composition from every angle. The library holds the shop's own gems, in their colours and sizes.

items.question: How does the two-day trial work?
items.answer: Create your account, then start the trial when you are ready: for 48 hours the Studio is yours with everything in the Essential plan, no card needed. The trial can be started once per account.

items.question: What happens after the trial ends?
items.answer: The editor closes and shows you the plans. Your creations and Gem Groups stay in your account: you find them again as soon as you subscribe.

items.question: Which subscription should I choose?
items.answer: Essential to imagine your first looks: 10 creations and 3 Gem Groups, the whole library and the Global Toothgems templates. Artist to work with your clients and show your work online: 50 creations, 15 Gem Groups, the front view, the placement sheet and sharing by link, folders to file your creations, social posts signed with your logo and your public Glowbook. Atelier to grow your business: unlimited creations and Gem Groups, online booking from your Glowbook and a calendar synced with yours, a place in the “Find an artist” directory, the AI try-on, which lets your clients see your creations on their own smile, and layouts for your posts.

items.question: What is the Glowbook, included from the Artist plan?
items.answer: Your public artist page, to put in your Instagram bio: your creations in 3D and your salon or your area on a map, with a QR code and a poster to print. With the Atelier plan it also takes your bookings: you set your hours and clients book a one-hour slot, with confirmation and reminder e-mails; your appointments are added to your Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook, and the hours already taken in that calendar close by themselves. If you wish, your page also appears in the “Find an artist” directory, where clients look for an artist near them. Your page and your creations are approved by our team before they go public.

items.question: Can I change my subscription later?
items.answer: Yes, at any time from My subscription: a plan change is prorated on your next invoice. If you move to a smaller plan you keep all your creations — you save new ones once under the limit — and your Glowbook is hidden while you are below the Artist plan; below Atelier, bookings and the directory stop. You can cancel for the end of the paid period, and withdraw within 14 days of your first payment.

items.question: Do I need experience with 3D design to get started?
items.answer: No. You pick a piece, place it on a tooth and move it with the mouse, a finger or the keyboard; the view turns with a drag. A help page comes with the editor.
